history.sg_progress: The implementation of this recommendation will require changes to the current framework of reimbursement. Those changes would require agreement in the Working Group on Contingent-Owned Equipment and approval by the General Assembly. The Administration will submit an issue paper for consideration at the 2023 meeting of the Working Group. Once a decision has been made in the Working Group and endorsed by the Assembly, the Administration will begin to implement the recommendation.
